findings.text: The new proof removes the last client of `resolvedStepOutput_notExistsExcept_hasRows` and its purge-specific laws, but the model still exports the replaced proof path. Fix: Move the four former statements into the retention fixture required by Form B, prove them from the general laws, and delete the unused package declarations.

The model docstring describes the complement law through the guide’s purge claim and leaves its `AND` premise implicit. Fix: State directly that when `(a AND b) IS NOT 1` is true, `a AND b` does not select the row.

The revised proof sketch omits the distinct-rowid premise that lets equal first cells identify the same source row. Fix: State that equal projected rows have the same stored rowid and that rowids are distinct in the admitted table.

The status records passing results for two local checks, although `AGENTS.md` permits status files to cite results only from Nix checks. Fix: Keep the names of the checks run and remove their local pass results.
